answer: A sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities. Entry takes a 50-POA levy that sinks like rain into karst, unrefundable. A quill records each deposit on the ledger; epochs earn 10% decay, floored at 5 POA. Spot audits are the lantern: scripted work restores the full levy. Cost ledger: N fakes pay N x 50 POA with zero salvage; bought keys reset the clock, so bought seniority fails. Honest agents pay once and earn rewards undiluted by clones.
